name: Level_1 - Task_1
description: Prepare liquid silicon at 2500 K for a later diffusion calculation. Start from the supplied mp-149 conventional cell and repeat it 3 × 3 × 3 to make 216 atoms. Use LAMMPS with metal units, full atom style, and the supplied Stillinger–Weber potential. Initialize the velocities at 300 K with a recorded random seed. Heat the same system continuously from 300 K to 2500 K at 2.2 K/ps under isotropic NPT at zero target pressure. Choose suitable simulation and sampling settings. Do not replace the structure, change the cell by hand, or reinitialize the velocities during heating. Save the prepared state, the state at 2500 K, the input and log files, and a time-resolved record of target temperature, measured temperature, pressure, and density. Briefly assess whether the final state is suitable for the later liquid-diffusion run.
submission_format: Submit the path to one JSON manifest inside the task workspace. Fill the fields used by this task and link the saved data, settings, and scripts needed to check them. The shared blank manifest also has fields for later Level 2 work; leave those fields empty. Paths may be relative to the manifest.
